summary: A list of articles that grows as the user reads, such as a timeline. Page keys move from article to article.

loading.description: More articles are being added; assistive technology waits before reading the change.

root.note: Stacks its articles with a gap.

keys.PageDown, PageUp: Move focus to the next or the previous article.
keys.Control+End, Control+Home: Move focus to the first focusable element after or before the feed.

events.more: Dispatched when focus reaches the last article, so that the page can add more.

guidance.text: Its articles are its child elements with the article role, native article elements among them. The feed makes each focusable and numbers them with aria-posinset and aria-setsize.
The author names the feed, and each article with aria-labelledby pointing at its heading.
